{"id":1771291580,"question_id":3953,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"10 months, 1 week","timestamp":1757919612,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"83 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1771291580/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":" Minimum Discards to Balance Inventory","memory":"134.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minArrivalsToDiscard(vector<int>& arrivals, int w, int m) {\n        int d = 0;\n        unordered_map<int, int> mp;\n        int i = 0;\n        int j = 0;\n        while(j < w){\n            mp[arrivals[j]]++;\n            if(mp[arrivals[j]] > m){\n                mp[arrivals[j]]--;\n                arrivals[j] = -1;\n                d++;\n            }\n            j++;\n        }\n        while(j  < arrivals.size()){\n            if(arrivals[i] != -1){\n                mp[arrivals[i]]--;\n            }\n            i++;\n\n            mp[arrivals[j]]++;\n            if(mp[arrivals[j]] > m){\n                mp[arrivals[j]]--;\n                arrivals[j] = -1;\n                d++;\n            }\n            j++;\n\n        }\n        return d;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-discards-to-balance-inventory","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":808}
